Iowa Family Chiropractic Ames is a highly-rated clinic in Ames providing care for families and individuals.

  • Focuses on neurologically-based chiropractic care.
  • Offers specific adjustment techniques for pediatric and prenatal health.

Platinum Chiropractic provides specialized care with a focus on structural correction.

  • Utilizes detailed structural analysis and digital imaging.
  • Features a range of services from pain relief to wellness maintenance.

Read Health Center Inc is located on Golden Aspen Drive and offers a personalized approach to chiropractic wellness.

  • Specializes in treating sports injuries, headaches, and chronic back pain.
  • Provides manual therapy and wellness coaching.

Rebarcak Chiropractic Pain Relief Center is a long-standing local practice known for its extensive hours and accessibility.

  • Offers same-day appointments and emergency care options.
  • Provides massage therapy and rehabilitation exercises alongside adjustments.

Ames Spine & Sport focuses on active recovery and performance-based care.

  • Integrates soft tissue work and corrective exercises.
  • Commonly serves athletes and individuals looking for sports-specific injury prevention.

These local practices offer a variety of specialized treatments ranging from pediatric care to sports rehabilitation, ensuring options for different health needs.
